A-H1.name: restoration specificity
A-H1.statement: At l*_restore, the same-set donor turns False-Yes into No more often than the C1 donor.
A-H1.estimate: mean over confirmation-half units of [success(same-set donor) - success(C1 donor)] at l*_restore
A-H1.weighting: each unit equal weight; image counts 3-5 and positions (first, middle) pooled

A-H2.name: contamination specificity
A-H2.statement: At l*_contaminate, the same-set donor turns Correct-No into Yes more often than the C1 donor.
A-H2.estimate: mean over confirmation-half units of [success(same-set donor) - success(C1 donor)] at l*_contaminate
A-H2.weighting: each unit equal weight (an N-last recipient enters once per unit); image counts and positions pooled

hypotheses.note: A-H1 and A-H2 are decided separately; neither changes any STEP 5-2 / 5-2b decision.

decision.level: 97.5% intervals (Bonferroni for two primary hypotheses), N-image cluster bootstrap

A-H1.supported: estimate >= 0.15 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI lower bound > 0
A-H1.robust_label: 'robust support' only if the class cluster 97.5% CI lower bound is also > 0; otherwise 'support (cross-class generalization uncertain)'

A-H2.supported: estimate >= 0.15 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI lower bound > 0
A-H2.robust_label: 'robust support' only if the class cluster 97.5% CI lower bound is also > 0; otherwise 'support (cross-class generalization uncertain)'

statistics.method: percentile cluster bootstrap; 97.5% for A-H1 / A-H2, 95% for secondary and descriptive results (labelled)
statistics.resampling_unit: the unit's N image ID, within the confirmation half; C1 donors stay fixed
